memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, walks 2 km daily.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait normal, TUG 9 sec (low risk).
medicines: 8 regular (amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, HCTZ 12.5 mg OD, methotrexate 10 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg weekly, hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD, prednisolone 5 mg OD) – polypharmacy, review Beers criteria.
mood: reports occasional low mood, denies depression.
carers: spouse Rajesh, husband.
goal: "I want to stay active and keep working without pain."
